sonnet.problem: The opening card (stop 1, card 1) already says David is "the man God chose to be the next king." That gives away the answer "king" for this later fill-in-the-blank, where the wrong answers are priest and judge.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Story card 8 quotes "May the LORD judge between you and me, and may the LORD take vengeance on you…" Right before this card, that shows the LORD takes the vengeance, which gives away that David won't take vengeance with his own hand.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The right answer ("Not to cut off his descendants or wipe out his name") is much longer and more detailed than the two wrong answers, so it stands out.
sonnet.rule: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly.
